targets.name: Invoice / Receipt App
targets.userUseCase: A merchant or app gets a payment plus order, refund, or error state that can be indexed from accepted transaction payloads.
targets.mainstreamReference: Checkout, payment proof, and receipt APIs are common crypto entry points because they do not require users to understand DeFi.
targets.liquidityOrAttentionReason: Payments are the clearest path to repeat non-speculative usage and can become the state layer for later apps.
targets.smallestHonestPrototype: Durable invoice state that replays accepted paid, refund, and error payload transactions without local keys.
targets.doNotClaimYet: Do not claim production merchant payments or mainnet app guarantees.

targets.name: Escrow / Freelance / Marketplace
targets.userUseCase: A buyer funds a job, the seller gets paid on release, and timeout refund or mutual cancel handles failure.
targets.mainstreamReference: Escrow, marketplaces, and freelance payouts are familiar user-facing crypto custody workflows.
targets.liquidityOrAttentionReason: A clear escrow app demonstrates why covenants matter in a way normal users understand.
missingRails: fresh expendable outputs for rejection tests
targets.smallestHonestPrototype: A freelance escrow demo that imports accepted funding, release, refund, and cancel proof state.
targets.doNotClaimYet: Do not claim mainnet escrow or audited production custody.

targets.name: Batch Assurance / Public-Goods Funding
targets.userUseCase: Many contributors pledge toward a target; release is planned only from accepted matched outputs and refunds remain explicit.
targets.mainstreamReference: Crowdfunding, grants, and public-goods funding have proven attention value across crypto ecosystems.
targets.liquidityOrAttentionReason: Visible funding targets can attract community participation and demonstrate group custody rules.
targets.smallestHonestPrototype: A campaign that settles only from imported accepted pledge outputs matching the required amounts.
targets.doNotClaimYet: Do not claim pooled covenant target enforcement until the script or proof model exists.

targets.name: Wallet-Facing Submit Console
targets.userUseCase: A user reviews exact transaction fields, payload bytes, route, and risk before signing or submitting.
targets.mainstreamReference: Every successful crypto app eventually needs wallet-safe transaction review instead of shell scripts.
targets.liquidityOrAttentionReason: No app becomes usable until users can submit without local private keys.
targets.smallestHonestPrototype: A no-local-key review flow that refuses routes known to drop payload bytes.
targets.doNotClaimYet: Do not claim wallet integration until a real connector signs and submits the exact reviewed transaction.

targets.name: Access Passes / Coupons / Tickets
targets.userUseCase: An issuer creates passes, tickets, coupons, or redeemable claims and the app tracks accepted redemptions.
targets.mainstreamReference: Token-gated access, tickets, coupons, and loyalty passes are familiar low-friction crypto products.
targets.liquidityOrAttentionReason: Consumer passes are understandable and can ship before deep DeFi rails.
targets.smallestHonestPrototype: A pass redemption dashboard tied to accepted payload bytes and duplicate review rules.
targets.doNotClaimYet: Do not claim protocol-native ticket enforcement.

targets.name: Auction / Intent Marketplace
targets.userUseCase: Users submit bids or intents, the app derives winner/refund planning from accepted payloads, and settlement remains explicit.
targets.mainstreamReference: NFT markets, intent markets, and auctions have repeatedly drawn users and volume on other chains.
targets.liquidityOrAttentionReason: Auctions can create visible activity, but custody and settlement must be disciplined.
targets.smallestHonestPrototype: An accepted-payload auction board with winner/refund state and no atomic exchange claim.
targets.doNotClaimYet: Do not claim MEV resistance or atomic settlement.

targets.name: Vault / Treasury / Team Wallet
targets.userUseCase: A user, family, DAO, or team can use delayed withdrawals, recovery, spend caps, and payroll templates.
targets.mainstreamReference: Wallet safety, multisig-like controls, and treasury operations are durable crypto use cases.
targets.liquidityOrAttentionReason: Business custody and safer wallets can attract serious users even before speculative DeFi.
targets.smallestHonestPrototype: A team vault plan that shows which controls are script enforced and which are wallet policy.
targets.doNotClaimYet: Do not claim script-enforced payroll caps until drafts and proofs exist.

targets.name: Simple Assets / Redeemable Claims
targets.userUseCase: An issuer creates credits, vouchers, claims, or recoverable units and tracks redemption state.
targets.mainstreamReference: Tokens, vouchers, and redeemable assets are a major crypto onboarding pattern.
targets.liquidityOrAttentionReason: Asset rails can attract users, but overclaiming native enforcement would damage trust.
targets.smallestHonestPrototype: Issuer-indexed redeemable claims with accepted issuance/redemption payloads.
targets.doNotClaimYet: Do not claim native Kaspa assets or stablecoins.

targets.name: Stable-Value Issuer App
targets.userUseCase: An issuer records issuance and redemption requests with reserve and redemption policy visible to users.
targets.mainstreamReference: Stablecoins and redeemable value units are among the strongest liquidity magnets in crypto.
targets.liquidityOrAttentionReason: Stable-value rails attract liquidity, but require strong issuer, reserve, legal, and risk boundaries.
missingRails: oracle or collateral model for non-issuer variants
targets.smallestHonestPrototype: A transparent issuer redemption ledger with no native-stablecoin claim.
targets.doNotClaimYet: Do not claim decentralized stablecoin, overcollateralized lending, or native stable asset support.

targets.name: DEX / AMM / Lending / Perps
targets.userUseCase: Users trade, provide liquidity, borrow, lend, hedge, or take leveraged positions.
targets.mainstreamReference: DEXs, lending markets, and perps are among the highest-liquidity app categories on mature chains.
targets.liquidityOrAttentionReason: These categories bring liquidity and attention, but they require the most missing rails.
missingRails: oracle or price source trust model
targets.smallestHonestPrototype: One-page app briefs and simulations that name the rails before any trading/custody claim.
targets.doNotClaimYet: Do not claim live DEX, lending, perps, prediction settlement, or investment advice.

rules: High-impact categories stay in the pipeline, but claims follow current rails.
Build-now means the repo has accepted transaction, payload, covenant, or wallet-review evidence to extend.
Research means the user job is worth tracking but the missing rails must be named before product claims.
Every app target must name what not to claim yet.
